insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change affects orders updated through the GraphQL Admin API. Previously, tax recalculations did not occur when the shipping address was changed.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware that updating an order's shipping address will now trigger a tax recalculation. This may impact custom tax calculations or integrations with third-party tax services. Ensure that your app handles this change correctly, especially if you are using the orderUpdate mutation. You may need to update your code to account for the new tax calculations.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order, ensuring compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change ensures accurate tax calculations and compliance with tax regulations, providing a better experience for merchants and their customers.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality and developer tools

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP tools are available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores. The `orderCreate` mutation also supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment.

themes.title: Developer Tools and Infrastructure
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. Additionally, Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing for Hydrogen storefront deployments.
